scope: Exact descriptive report arithmetic and a separately materialized raw-row counterpart; no model fit, power, N_min, calibration or scientific admission. Expected values fixed before reading the new diagnostics implementation.

moment_conventions.grid: All six aligned time slots remain, including no eligible contributions.
moment_conventions.lag_pairs: Ordered t-k,t without circular wrap; k=0 included; no pairs yields null, not zero.
moment_conventions.contribution_center: Global full-grid mean and divisor T-k for positive available pair count.
moment_conventions.outcome_center: Each instrument eligible-outcome marginal mean; report actual paired counts and pair means separately. This centered product is not generally pairwise-centered covariance.
moment_conventions.score: T*(Z-muC*C)/totalC - T*(S-q*N)/totalN. Undefined if either required total is zero.
moment_conventions.unknown_condition: Eligible unknown conditions remain in N and S but not C or Z.
moment_conventions.noneligible: Zero contribution is not an observed zero outcome. Preserve each ineligibility state.
